title: Ammochryse
summary: AM'MOCHRYSE, noun am'mokris. [Gr. sand and gold.] A yellow soft stone, found in Germany, consisting of glossy yellow particles. When rubbed or ground, it is used to strew over writing, like black sand

inlines.v: AM'MOCHRYSE, noun am'mokris. [Gr. sand and gold.] A yellow soft stone, found in Germany, consisting of glossy yellow particles. When rubbed or ground, it is used to strew over writing, like black sand with us.
